create_mbop_networks: create all MBOP networks at once using make_networks with an environment spec and hidden layer sizes
create_world_model_network: create a world model network that predicts next observations and rewards from observations and actions
create_policy_prior_network: create a policy prior network that predicts actions from observations and previous actions
create_n_step_return_network: create an N-step return network that predicts returns from observations and actions
wrap_haiku_module_as_network: wrap a Haiku transformed module into a FeedForwardNetwork using make_network_from_module with an environment spec
